description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of different relational association types evaluated in the MMRA benchmark, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and its associated count and percentage of the total. The chart is divided into ten distinct slices, each labeled with its category name, a numerical count, and its percentage contribution. Starting from the top and moving clockwise, the slices are: NearSameEntity (63, 6.34%, dark gray), RelativePosition (81, 7.90%, light gray), MentalitySimilarity (89, 8.67%, light cyan), SimilarEvent (90, 8.77%, blue), AppearanceSimilarity (90, 8.77%, light green), Layout (90, 8.77%, pale yellow), UsageSimilarity (100, 9.65%, reddish-brown), SubEvent (100, 9.74%, red), SimilarMaterial (106, 10.33%, orange), and ObservationAngle (126, 12.28%, teal). Each slice is clearly labeled with its category name, numerical value, and percentage, and the chart does not include a separate legend since the labels are directly on the slices. The slices appear to be ordered in descending size, with ObservationAngle being the largest and NearSameEntity the smallest. There is no visual emphasis such as exploded slices or bolded text; all segments are presented in a standard pie chart format.
